description: TileLang GEMV example splitk_gemv (N = K = 1024, BLOCK_N = 32, BLOCK_K = 32, reduce_threads = 32): C = B @ A over an f16 matrix B [N, K] and vector A [K] with f32 accumulation, a 32 x 32 thread block: thread (n, k) sums a one-element slice of each 32-element K step of row n, the 32 partial sums combined by atomic adds to a shared f32 accumulator; one CTA of 32 x 32 threads, the block-0 one, computing C's first 32 elements; compiled by extraction/tilelang_kernels.py
